name: Wave Memory Assist
description: Record your own wave inputs, then queue early presses/releases and execute only when the saved timing matches. No noclip, no autoplay.

record-next.name: Record next run (100% required)
record-next.description: Turn on, restart the level and beat it normally. A completed run overwrites the current level reference. After success this toggle switches itself off.

early-frames.name: Early window (physics frames)
early-frames.description: 0 = exact timing, 20 = your PRESS and RELEASE may happen up to 20 simulation ticks before the saved event. Out-of-window input is discarded, never noclipped.
